title: BBOX Battery Cassette Direct-Swap Interface Contract

coordinate_system.X: lateral; negative is rover left and positive is rover right
coordinate_system.Y: longitudinal; negative is rover front/forward and positive is rover rear/aft

existing_fixed_core.future_envelope_issue: A fixed BBOX-FRAME plus wet cradle and cassette may not fit the existing 200x150x120 body concept; CAD measurement is required before any dimension change.

position_rationale: short fixed feedthrough candidate to CBOX
avoids left and right upper motor-pod zones
separates vertical cassette weight from horizontal mating force
can remain protected beneath the opened/closed upper shell concept
known_conflicts: existing BBOX rear positive-Y top-open wire notch
existing CBOX front negative-Y top-open wire notch
fixed bulkhead service access not yet measured

internal_candidates: gas and pressure route away from operator and CBOX

transitions: moisture water sensor fault or unknown
full mate and secondary compression confirmed
class polarity temperature and BMS ready
contactor open and bus below threshold
full retraction and electrical disconnect confirmed

human_swap_sequence: place dirty cassette in dirty bay
frozen_invariants: commercial waterproof box compatibility is not required
BBOX and CBOX remain front rear in-series central core
CBOX remains a fixed dry core
BBOX structural frame remains fixed to rover
only battery cassette is routinely exchanged
cassette has standalone primary waterproof enclosure
wet cradle is gravity drainable
connector is high-mounted
bottom exposed connector is prohibited
connector carries no cassette structural load
vertical top insertion is baseline
horizontal connector shuttle is baseline
connector dry zone uses dual seal and drain moat
CBOX boundary uses fixed sealed feedthrough
removed cassette terminals are dead-front
traction hot-swap is prohibited
energization before both latches is prohibited
energization with wet detection is prohibited
pre-charge is required candidate
main contactor control is required candidate

clean dirty and fault cassettes are physically separated
water-field swap is prohibited
V001 uses human swap baseline
manufacturing purchase and field deployment are not approved
